segments.sn36.2:1.3: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā – imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso vedanāti.
segments.sn36.2:2.1: “Sukhaṃ vā yadi vā dukkhaṃ, adukkhamasukhaṃ saha;
segments.sn36.2:2.3: Ajjhattañca bahiddhā ca, yaṃ kiñci atthi veditaṃ.
segments.sn36.2:3.3: Phussa phussa vayaṃ passaṃ, evaṃ tattha virajjatī”ti.

lines: Ajjhattañca bahiddhā cāti attano ca parassa ca.
Phussa phussa vayaṃ passanti ñāṇena phusitvā phusitvā vayaṃ passanto.
Evaṃ tattha virajjatīti evaṃ tāsu vedanāsu virajjati.
Idhāpi sutte sammasanacāravedanā kathitā, gāthāsu ñāṇaphusanaṃ.
Dukkhaṃ na hotīti adukkhaṃ, sukhaṃ na hotīti asukhaṃ, ma -kāro padasandhikaro.
Saparasantānagate sandhāya ajjhattabahiddhāgahaṇanti āha “attano ca parassa cā”ti.
Ñāṇena phusitvā phusitvāti pubbabhāge vipassanāñāṇena aniccā pabhaṅgunoti ārammaṇato, uttarakālaṃ asammohato maggaparamparāya phusitvā phusitvā vayaṃ passanto.
